name_or_item: Leyland 500 series fixed-head engine - routine maintenance
source_ref: AROnline, 'The 500-Series: Leyland loses its head' (2011); Commercial Motor, 4 May 1979; Commercial Motor, 30 August 1968 (design claims)
notes: Confidence: low-medium. Valve access needs special tools and separation of the block; poor casting tolerances; melted piston crowns; repowering with Gardner, DAF or Volvo. The engine was designed for 300,000 miles between overhauls (CM 1968), so the gap between claim and service is the story.
